generations.zh: 当前代。官方 README：2.8T 总参 MoE（Stable LatentMoE，896 专家激活 16），KDA + AttnRes 架构，原生多模态（文本/图像/视频），1M token 上下文；「world's first open 3T-class model」为厂商自评口径。
generations.en: Current generation. Official README: a 2.8T-parameter MoE (Stable LatentMoE, 16 of 896 experts active), KDA + AttnRes architecture, native multimodality (text/image/video), 1M-token context; "world's first open 3T-class model" is vendor-run wording.

generations.zh: 上一代线：K2 / K2-Instruct / K2-Thinking / K2.5 / K2.6 / K2.7-Code 等在官方 org 在册（2025-07 起）。
generations.en: Previous line: K2 / K2-Instruct / K2-Thinking / K2.5 / K2.6 / K2.7-Code listed in the official org (from July 2025).

generations.zh: 并行支线：视觉语言 Kimi-VL-A3B 与线性注意力 Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B（官方 org 在册）。
generations.en: Parallel branches: the vision-language Kimi-VL-A3B line and the linear-attention Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B (official org).

sizeTiers.zh: 旗舰 2.8T MoE（K3，激活数官方未逐条公开）
sizeTiers.en: Flagship 2.8T MoE (K3; active count not itemised officially)

licenses.zh: Kimi K3 License（模型卡 license_name: "kimi-k3"，非 OSI 标准许可，下载前读原文）
licenses.en: Kimi K3 License (model-card license_name "kimi-k3"; not an OSI-standard licence — read the text before download)

claims.zh: 官方 README：「a 2.8T-parameter model built on Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) and Attention Residuals (AttnRes), with native vision capabilities and a 1-million-token context window」「activates 16 out of 896 experts — yielding an approximate 2.5× improvement in overall scaling efficiency over Kimi K2」（2.5× 为厂商自评口径）。
claims.en: Official README: "a 2.8T-parameter model built on Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) and Attention Residuals (AttnRes), with native vision capabilities and a 1-million-token context window"; "activates 16 out of 896 experts — yielding an approximate 2.5× improvement in overall scaling efficiency over Kimi K2" (the 2.5× figure is vendor-run wording).

positioning.zh: 国产开放权重旗舰：K3 是官方口径的首个开放 3T 级模型，许可是自定义 Kimi K3 License。对话产品「Kimi 智能助手」在网信办首批备案（Beijing-MoonShot-20231016）；模型权重本身与备案是两回事，卡上分开写。
positioning.en: The domestic open-weight flagship: K3 is, per the vendor, the first open 3T-class model, under a custom Kimi K3 License. The consumer chat product was filed in the CAC's first batch (Beijing-MoonShot-20231016); model weights and service filing are different things — the card keeps them apart.

onSite.zh: 本站已收录 Kimi K3 的量化对比
onSite.en: This site covers Kimi K3 quantisations
